chains.title: Null: no TF-mediated allelic effect of rs7001688
predictions: No allele-specific TF binding at rs7001688 in Hep3B nuclear extract.
No allele-specific regulatory-element activity for ref G versus alt T.
No allelic effect on CYP7A1 or other local transcript; any LDL association is due to a linked causal variant or chance.
falsified_if: A reproducible allele-specific TF footprint, EMSA shift, or ChIP-qPCR difference is seen for ref versus alt in Hep3B cells.

chains.title: HNF4A binds ref G more and activates CYP7A1

links.claim: HNF4A binds the ref G allele more strongly than the alt T allele at rs7001688, consistent with disruption of a candidate HNF4A motif; direct evidence not supplied.
rs7001688 lies in a candidate hepatocyte-active regulatory element whose activity depends on the HNF4A site.
The element regulates CYP7A1 transcription in hepatocytes.
Hep3B is an appropriate model because HNF4A and CYP7A1 are expressed in hepatocyte-lineage cells.
Ref G increases HNF4A-dependent CYP7A1 expression, increasing bile-acid synthesis and lowering LDL cholesterol.

predictions: Ref G shows stronger HNF4A EMSA/ChIP signal than alt T in Hep3B.
Ref G increases CYP7A1 reporter activity and CYP7A1 expression.
Ref G is associated with lower LDL cholesterol through this element.
falsified_if: No ref>alt HNF4A binding is detected, HNF4A supershift fails, or CYP7A1 expression is not allele-dependent in hepatocytes.

chains.title: HNF1A binds alt T more and represses CYP7A1

links.claim: HNF1A binds the alt T allele more strongly than ref G at rs7001688, creating a candidate HNF1A site; direct evidence not supplied.
The alt T allele increases occupancy of a repressive hepatocyte regulatory element.
The repressive element lowers CYP7A1 transcription.
Hep3B is relevant because HNF1A is expressed in hepatocyte-lineage cells.
Alt T increases HNF1A-mediated repression of CYP7A1, reducing bile-acid synthesis and raising LDL cholesterol.

predictions: Alt T shows stronger HNF1A EMSA/ChIP signal than ref G.
Alt T lowers CYP7A1 reporter activity and CYP7A1 expression.
Alt T is associated with higher LDL cholesterol through this element.
falsified_if: No alt>ref HNF1A binding is detected, HNF1A supershift fails, or CYP7A1 is not repressed by the alt allele.

outcomes.outcome: Ref G binds HNF4A more strongly

next_experiment: Run allele-specific EMSA with Hep3B nuclear extract using ref-G and alt-T probes, then HNF4A antibody supershift; this directly tests the top two chains C0 vs C1. If HNF4A binds ref G more strongly, C1 is favored; if binding is allele-independent or HNF4A supershift fails, C0 is favored.
